title: Coca-Cola's India bottler files for an IPO #Shorts
description: Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings filed its draft prospectus with SEBI on 6 Nov: up to 99.75 crore shares, all an offer for sale by the promoter. Apr-Jun 2026 revenue Rs 4,310.17 crore (+20.46%), but FY26 revenue fell about 9%. Price band and dates are not announced. Source: Kotak Neo, IPOGuru. Follow Fin Pulse for market updates. Not financial advice. #Shorts #IPO #CocaCola #SEBI #StockMarket
